title: Suggestions — choose a path before anything is implemented
how_to_read: Nothing here has been implemented. Pick one path per row; implementation starts only after the choice.

rows.title: Licensed closing-line feed, with a labelled "non-official" status
rows.problem: Price-snapshot store is empty; every market-based gate (G6) and the demotion gate are unevaluable.
rows.proposal: Procure a rights-cleared archive of opening and closing spreads/totals/moneylines for 2026 weeks 1–18. Store with capture timestamps; show "licensed, non-official" status on every price cell.
rows.risk: Relaxes the official-only rule for price data only — a policy change.
rows.prerequisites: Owner approval of the policy change; licence check.

rows.title: Keep the price store empty and stay in research mode
rows.problem: Without prices, no ROI or CLV can be computed honestly.
rows.proposal: Publish the framework only; do not paper-trade; revisit at the start of the 2027 season.
rows.risk: No validation of any strategy this season.
rows.prerequisites: Owner choice; this is the default if SUG-L1 is not chosen.

rows.title: Find an official depth-chart source for starter/backup status
rows.problem: Replacement depth cannot be tracked, so depth-based demotion (D5) and the injury model cannot run.
rows.proposal: Search nfl.com team pages and official NFL data pages for a published depth chart; if none exists, record the gap as permanent and use only official injury designations.
rows.risk: If none exists, depth tracking stays impossible.
rows.prerequisites: Discovery task; no code change until a source is confirmed.

rows.title: Official per-game player logs for player-prop research
rows.problem: Player-prop combos (S5, S6) have no official data source.
rows.proposal: Identify an official player-statistics page with per-game logs; add capture only after verification.
rows.risk: Player-prop prices still needed for grading.

rows.title: Extend the walk-forward holdout before any promotion
rows.problem: Holdout n=30 cannot support a signal claim (Q-L4).
rows.proposal: Keep predicting prospectively through Week 18 and re-run the frozen gates on the enlarged holdout.

rows.title: Consolidate the 16 NFL namespaces into one generator
rows.problem: Parallel namespaces repeat content and drift (the root generator drops hand-added links; see F-L4).
rows.proposal: Merge into one source of truth in a dedicated integration task; leave old URLs as redirects.
rows.risk: Risk of broken links during migration.
rows.prerequisites: Owner choice; should not be done in parallel with other sessions.
